Commentary.Commentary: Right then. 133 needed for Sri Lanka to win. This is set up nicely for the hosts, as they will look to come out and level the series. The deck is slightly on the slower side and the Men in Blue have a good variety in their bowling attack. Should be an interesting chase. Join us for the same shortly.

Devdutt Padikkal is in for a chat! He says that the pitch was sticky. Says that they wanted to bat till the end and they did it. Says that they have put a comfortable total on the board and they have the bowlers to do it. Ends by saying it is exciting to make the debut.

It was spin that did the majority of the damage for the Lankans. Don't get us wrong, all of their bowlers were good, but their spinners just made life tough for the Indians. Akila Dananjaya was expensive in his very first over, but came back very nicely, finishing with the wickets of dangermen, Dhawan and Samson. Wanindu Hasaranga, again, impressed one and all, finishing with figures of 4-0-30-1, with his last over, being slightly expensive. Dushmantha Chameera was their premier pace bowler, as he took Rana's wicket, in his last over, but was very miserly as well. Shanaka was decent in his short spell of two overs.

A superb bowling performance from the hosts has seen them restrict India to a decent score, in 132. This deck was slightly on the slower side, and the spinners of the Islanders used the game to good effect and have ended the first innings, on top. The Men in Blue looked solid at the start, with Dhawan and Gaikwad. They played slowly but kept the scorecard jogging. Once Gaikwad fell, scoring runs became slightly harder. Dhawan and Padikkal raised a good stand, but that too, did not last for long. Padikkal and Samson went back one after the other. Rana and Kumar tried hard to get that final flourish, but never found it and have finished their innings on a slightly sub-par total.
Just a single to end then! On off, a low full toss, it is hit to mid off for one. So no boundaries in the last over! INDIA END WITH 132!
On off, fuller again, this is pushed to covers for one.
Navdeep Saini walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is brilliant deception! Done in completely by the slower one. It is full and outside off, Rana initially looks to go over covers but then realizes he is way too early in the shot. He tries to stop but ends up chipping it to the man at covers.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: BYE! Good from Rana. This is short again, Kumar looks to play the upper cut again but misses. Rana knows he has to get back on strike and steals a bye.
A short one, Kumar looks to upper cut it but misses.
A full ball on off, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
Hit well but only for one! On middle, the slog sweep is out, it goes towards deep square leg for one.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs! Hasaranga sees the batter go for the reverse sweep and fires it down the leg side. Rana lets it be. The keeper fails to collect it and it goes to the fence. Bonus runs and much needed.

Brilliant fielding! This is bowled outside off, Kumar swings, this goes off the inside edge, just past the off pole and down towards the fine leg fence. Akila runs after it and then dives, pushes it back in, saves a run for his side.
Another heave, it is the googly which lands outside off, it goes through mid-wicket for a couple.
Floats it up outside off, Kumar, looks to go over covers but it goes back off the inner to the bowler. Dots are gold dust.
Two! Kumar comes down the track and hits it over the bowler's head. Not a lot of power in it but two taken.
Rana brings out the sweep, this goes more off the inner half towards short fine leg for one.
Wanindu Hasaranga will bowl the penultimate over.
Just another single to end! No boundary in the over and Sri Lanka would love it that way! Another one full and around off, Rana strokes it towards cover and takes another one.
Dots are gold dust at this stage. A full ball on off, Rana jams it out towards cover.

Really good shot but the field is set nicely! A short one and on middle, Rana waits and then ramps it over the keeper. Third man is quite fine. The fielder there runs to his right and keeps it down to two.
Another one! Shorter in length and outside off, Kumar slashes at it, this goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Just the one again! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! Way too short and down the leg side. Left alone. Not sure if short balls are what you want to bowl on a wicket which is holding quite a lot.
A low full toss on middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Dushmantha Chameera is back into the attack.

One more! On the stumps, this is hit down to long on. They want a second but the fielder at long on runs to his right, gets to the ball, his shoe comes off as he tries to throw it but still does not concede the second.
TWO! On middle, this turns away. Kumar looks to work it on the leg side but this one goes off the leading edge past the slip fielder for two.
Who will walk out now? It is Bhuvneshwar Kumar.

OUT! TIMBER! Samson falls now and the Sri Lankan spinners are spinning a web around the Indians who are in a big hole right now. This is a lucky dismissal. Samson comes down the track and the length is shortened. On middle, holds its line. Samson looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and then rolls behind onto the stumps. Samson had no idea where the ball is, he realized late, did try to stop it from rolling onto the wickets but fails to do so. Into the all-rounders now are Lanka. Can they keep India under 130?
TWO WIDES. Fired in quicker and down leg, Rana looks to sweep this but he misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters sneak a run. Wide signaled too.
Just the one again! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one more.
Just the one! Singles won't harm Lanka a lot! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Very clever! Sees the batter position himself for the reverse sweep so fires it outside off, Rana looks to drag it but he hits it onto his own pad.
Another beauty to end! This lands on off and then spins away. Samson goes back to defend but is beaten. A brilliant comeback by the bowler after going for a boundary early on in this over.
He gets off the mark! On middle, this is pushed down to the fielder at long on for one. 100 up for India.
Floats it up on middle, Rana wants a sighter so defends.
Nitish Rana walks out to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Hasaranga has the last laugh and this is a big wicket. Padikkal was set and just as he would have tried to up the ante, he falls. This is a loopy ball, it is fuller and around off, Padikkal looks to sweep but misses. This turns back in and hits the off pole. India enter into the last 5 with relatively new batters, just what Sri Lanka wanted.

FOUR! That is a tremendous stroke! Probably more effective on such wickets but you need to hit it well. The reverse sweep is out. Padikkal gets into position early, it is tossed up outside off. Devdutt hits it over point for a welcome boundary. Is this the start of something for the Indians?
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Samson cuts it to point for a single.
On middle, flicked to the square leg for a single.
BEATEN! Flatter ball outside off. Devdutt Padikkal looks to dab it away but misses it.

In the air..safe! Pitches it up, outside off. Devdutt Padikkal comes down the track and reaches to the pitch of the ball, goes for the slash but gets the outer half, high in the air and towards long off. The fielder there charges ahead but does not reach to it. Two taken.
Again a shorter ball outside off. Samson rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, this is flicked to the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball on middle. Samson defends it out.

Was that a chance? A shorter ball, it lands on middle and spins away sharply. Samson waits for it and looks to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads, and then towards the keeper, who fails to collect it.
On middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Devdutt Padikkal strides forward inside the line and nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, drilled to long on for another one.
Starts with a googly, on middle. Devdutt Padikkal waits and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga is back into the attack now!
Angles it on the pads. This is clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single. Good over from Akila, just 4 runs and a big wicket of Dhawan.
Slightly shorter and outside off. Samson steps across and drags it to long on for a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Pushed to long off for another single.
On middle. Samson flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark!
Flatter and way outside off. Samson pushes it to covers.
Sanju Samson walks out to bat!

OUT! BOWLED! The pressure was building on India and Dhawan had to go for the big shot! Angles a full ball on middle and leg. Shikhar Dhawan gets on his knee and goes for the slog sweep but misses it completely. The ball sneaks under his bat and rattles the stump.
Akila Dananjaya is on! He was expensive in his first over but can he comeback strongly here?
On middle. This is drilled down to mid-wicket for another couple. So, 10 runs coming off this over.
A slower length ball around the off pole. Devdutt Padikkal charges down the track and misses the heave. The ball whizzes past the off pole.
Did you know? Devdutt Padikkal is the 88th player that has represented India in the T20I format.
A short ball outside off. Devdutt Padikkal gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Good running between the wickets.
Full this time, on middle. Dhawan drives it to covers. A fumble allows a single.
WIDE! A short of a length ball way outside off. Left alone. Wide given.
Good length ball way outside off. Dhawan makes room on the off side and looks to slash but misses it.
FOUR! Good shot! India now changing the gears! A length ball on off. Dhawan steps across and paddles it over square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Much needed for India. First maximum as well. Tosses it up on middle. Devdutt Padikkal gets into the position and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tossed up, fuller and on middle. Dhawan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, it lands and spins away. Devdutt Padikkal comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full on middle. Dhawan works it to the on side for one more.
Flatter and outside off, stays low off the deck. Devdutt Padikkal slaps it to covers for a single.
Again looks to reverse sweep but does not get the middle! Mendis goes full again as he sees Dhawan get into position early. Dhawan looks to hit it hard but does so onto his feet.
Just the one again. DP happy to take singles at the moment. On off, it is pushed down to long off for one.
This is now given a lot of flight, it lands outside off, Dhawan looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half down to long off for one.
FOUR! Is that the release shot India and Dhawan needed? Really good, skips down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it hard past long off for a boundary.

That was ugly! Dhawan got into position very early to play the reverse sweep but this is bowled very full and on off, it lands and turns away. Dhawan misses, loses his balance. The keeper appeals for a catch but nothing.
On middle, Padikkal hangs back and works it through square leg for one.

Was that a chance? Maybe no! Fires it full and wide outside off, Dhawan has a heave across the line but misses. A good start by Dhananjaya but India are finding it very difficult to score at the moment.
Flatter and quicker on off, Dhawan plays it late towards point but another dot.
Another single! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Dhawan looks to sweep, he had to drag it from well outside off, it goes towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Attacks the stumps and lands it on middle, Dhawan looks to drop and run but it is another dot.
Very full and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Dhananjaya de Silva is into the attack now.
Padikkal is off the mark for India! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
That is a beauty! Just a beauty to get first up! This lands on midde and then turns away viciously. Padikkal looks to defend but is beaten.
Just a single! 1 from the first 4 balls! On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Again! Fires it on off and gets it to turn away a little. SD once again finds the man at covers.
A little bit of turn! On off, this one spins away. Dhawan pushes it to covers.
Flatter and on off, Dhawan hangs back and pushes it to covers.
Who will walk out now? It is Devdutt Padikkal, on his debut. Also, Ramesh Mendis is into the attack as he is making his debut as well.

OUT! TAKEN! Gaikwad's struggle comes to an end! This is very smart bowling, he kept bowling the slower ones and this time bangs in a short one, a seam-up ball. Gaikwad may not have been expecting it as he is quite late in the pull. It goes off the top edge and it is a simple catch to the keeper, Minod Bhanuka. Shanaka breaks the opening stand. Sri Lanka doing well at the moment and Shanaka continues to impress with the ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Minod Bhanuka b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: Another really slow delivery, back of a hand slower one. Ruturaj is done in by the lack of pace, he just pushes it back gently to the bowler.
This is a good bumper! Gets some good bounce on this one. Dhawan gets hit high on the bat as he tries to pull, it goes towards mid-wicket for one.
Looks like Isuru Udana have stretched his hamstring. The physios are here and he is seen limping out of the ground. Not a good sight for the Sri Lanka supporters.
Nicely played! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side. Udana from short fine leg hares after it, he dives a little too early, can't stop the two. He looks in a little bit of pain.
Shorter, does not quite come onto the bat that well, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
BEATEN! Sees Gaikwad come down the track and shortens the length just a little. It is outside off, Ruturaj looks to cut but misses.
Change. Dasun Shanaka is in to bowl.
On the pads, flicked to the leg side. End of the Powerplay, India are at 45 for 0.
Very full and on middle. This is pushed to covers for one.
Loopy ball on middle. Dhawan pulls it to square leg for one.
Slightly shorter outside off. Gaikwad waits for it and guides it past short third man. The fielder gives a chase and does well to save a run for his team. Three taken.
Tossed up, fuller on middle. Dhawan tucks it on the leg side for one.
Starts with a flatter ball, spinning in, on middle. Ruturaj Gaikwad rocks back and cuts it to point for a quick single.
Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack!
On a length, around off, worked to the leg side. Gaikwad wanted a run, but Gabbar sent him back. Good call by the skipper!
Slower length ball, outside off, Dhawan misses his shot.

FOUR! Pierced the gap, this time. Good use of the feet. On a slower pace, length ball, on middle, Shikhar Dhawan puts on his dancing shoes and comes down the track. Converts it into a full toss and whips it through mid-wicket.

In the air...just short of the fielder in the deep. A full toss, around off, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets low and sweeps it uppishly towards deep square leg. The fielder runs ahead, but it falls ahead of him. A run.
Fuller in length, around off, knocked towards mid on for a quick single.
Slower ball, on middle, Ruturaj Gaikwad goes back and taps it to point for a run.
Isuru Udana is into the attack.
On the pads, kept out to the leg side.
Slightly around off, back of a length, blocked out by Dhawan.
Around off, pushed to point.
A back of a length ball, angling into the body, Dhawan misses his flick and gets hit on the pad.
On a good length, outside off, Ruturaj Gaikwad leans into the drive and strokes it through point. By the time Chamika Karunaratne chases and stops the ball, three are taken.
On a length, outside off, Dhawan slices this behind point, for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera has changed the ends.

In the air...safe! Just over the mid off fielder. Floated, around off, spinning away, Ruturaj Gaikwad gets low and plays the cover drive, but the away spin takes the outer half of the blade and lobs over mid off. A couple. 13 off the over.
Presses forward to a full ball, outside off, tapped to the off side and crosses ends.
Outside off, dabbed to the backward point fielder.
FOUR! Gabbar does not want to feel left behind. Scores his second boundary. Slightly flatter, outside off, this is cut away late, past the short third man fielder, for a boundary.
A full toss, around off, tapped towards covers for a run.

FOUR! The first boundary of the debutant, on the very ball of Akila Dananjaya's spell. Brilliant. This is tossed up, landing fuller on middle, Ruturaj Gaikwad makes room and plays the inside-out shot over the cover region for a boundary.
So, change straightaway as Akila Dananjaya is into the attack.
A good opening over by Chamika Karunaratne as he gives away just 6 runs. A length delivery, coming in, around off, dropped towards mid-wicket for one.
A touch low, a touch short, around off, pulled to the leg side.
Outside off, Dhawan gets low and bunts this through point. One run.
A short ball, on off, Dhawan is hurried into the pull and slightly awkwardly, hooks it through mid-wicket. Comes back for the second run.
Closer to the off pole, length, dabbed down towards third man for one.
Starts with a short of a length ball, around off and middle, pulled hard to deep square leg for a run.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Chamika Karunaratne.
A length ball, coming in, around middle, nudged to the on side.
A back of a length ball, on off, Gabbar sways back and taps this to third man. One run.
FOUR! The first boundary. Who else, but Gabbar? A good length delivery, around the off pole, Shikhar Dhawan beautifully punches this one past extra covers. Boundary.
A length ball, around off, nudged towards mid on for a run.
The Indian captain opens his account too. Does so, by pushing this length ball to mid off. There was a slight hesitation by Dhawan, but the fielder misses his throw at the non-striker's end.
A length ball, way outside off, Shikhar Dhawan looks to cut, but the ball takes the under edge and goes to the first slip, on the bounce.
TWO WIDES. Dushmantha Chameera loses his radar very early on. A length ball, down the leg side, the keeper is not able to stop it and palms it towards fine leg. One run is stolen. India are underway!

Right. Done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is all set to get underway. A lot has happened in the last couple of days, but we have arrived, to a point, from where the game can begin. The Sri Lankan players have spread out on the field. Dushmantha Chameera is seen warming up, getting ready to bowl, first-up. Shikhar Dhawan and Ruturaj Gaikwad will open the batting for India. Let's gooooo!
So, the four debutants for India are Devdutt Padikkal, Nitish Rana, Chetan Sakariya, and Ruturaj Gaikwad, as they make their way into the side.

India (PLAYING XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Ruturaj Gaikwad, Devdutt Padikkal, Sanju Samson (WK), Nitish Rana, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Kuldeep Yadav, Rahul Chahar, Navdeep Saini, Chetan Sakariya, Varun Chakravarthy.

Sri Lanka (PLAYING XI) - Avishka Fernando, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Dhananjaya de Silva, Dasun Shanaka (C), Ramesh Mendis, Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Isuru Udana, Akila Dananjaya, Dushmantha Chameera.

Shikhar Dhawan says that they would have batted first so they are happy. Says that they are looking forward to the game. Says that all the players are ready to perform. Says that he is glad that the other boys got their chance. Says that it has been hard to stay in the bubble for the past 45 days.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper says that the pitch looks the same as the first match. Feels that there might be some help for the bowlers. Informs that Ramesh Mendis will make his debut and Sadeera Samarawickrama is in the XI.
TOSS - Sri Lanka have won the toss and have ELECTED TO BOWL!
Murali Kartik informs that only Shikhar Dhawan, Nitish Rana, Devdutt Padikkal and Sanju Samson are the available Indian Batsmen.

Rahul Dravid is up for a chat, he says that since covid happened, there is a chance for the new players to take the opportunity. Adds that if they are selected in the squad, they have to be ready to play anytime. Says that no one is here for a holiday. Adds that it is good to give a chance to the youngsters and it is up to them to take the opportunity and to perform. Says that staying in the bubble is a hard challenge and they had just a little dampner as Krunal Pandya tested positive.

India have been in supreme form in the ODIs and have continued the same in the T20Is, as well. They have won the first one and are on course to win the series, but expect a bundle of changes to their side. This is the perfect opportunity for the Lankans to level the series, as this Indian side will lack in experience and also will showcase a lot of newbies. Should be an invigorating clash. Toss and team news up in a bit.

Hello, folks! Time for the second T20I between Sri Lanka and India. The game was delayed by a day as Krunal Pandya tested positive for Covid and hence, they had to ensure that they took the necessary precautions and decided that the game will take the next day and here we are. Eight members of the Indian contingent who have come in close contact with Krunal will not be taking part in the remaining 2 games. A lot has happened so far and hopefully, this game should live up to the billing as well.
